character.motivation: Raises trees for places he may never visit. Wants the nursery to take names from both sides of the flood.
character.voice: Gentle, precise, attentive to literal questions.
character.backstory: Joel started raising replacement trees after the flooded families lost their gardens. Some saplings outgrew their pots while he waited to learn where those families would settle.
character.quest_hook: Find the families Joel promised trees to and ask which of them still wants one and where it should grow.

dialogue.introduction: Children ask where seeds go at night. Grown-ups ask the same thing and call it accounting.
dialogue.friendship: I promised someone a tree that would bear fruit in her lifetime. I looked up the variety three times.
dialogue.supper: I took seedlings home from the table. I hope a few get planted where we can all pick from them.
dialogue.hearing: Put the new leases beside the nursery register. Let people see whose names are growing here now.
dialogue.favorite_gift: I'll save the seeds and mark who brought them.
dialogue.disliked_gift: That's too seedy for the small pots. Ness has a better use for it.

routine.home_context: Lives beside Lark and grows replacements for gardens lost below the gate.
